rows.text: | [Network Firewall no-source-preservation (proxy) mode](what-is-aws-network-firewall.md) | AWS Network Firewall now supports the no-source-preservation deployment mode, which allows the firewall to function as an explicit forward proxy that terminates client connections and re-establishes them to destinations using an attached NAT gateway's IP address. This feature is in public preview and is available only in the US East (Ohio) Region (us-east-2). The previously available deployment mode is now referred to as source-preservation mode. For more information, see [No-source-preservation mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/network-firewall/latest/developerguide/nfw-no-source-preservation.html). | August 3, 2026 |

cells.Description: AWS Network Firewall now supports the no-source-preservation deployment mode, which allows the firewall to function as an explicit forward proxy that terminates client connections and re-establishes them to destinations using an attached NAT gateway's IP address. This feature is in public preview and is available only in the US East (Ohio) Region (us-east-2). The previously available deployment mode is now referred to as source-preservation mode. For more information, see [No-source-preservation mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/network-firewall/latest/developerguide/nfw-no-source-preservation.html).

rows.text: | [Updated supported Suricata version to 8.0.3](stateful-rule-groups-ips.md) | Network Firewall upgraded from Suricata version 7.0 to 8.0.3. This might require changes in your use of Network Firewall. Notably, WebSocket is now identified as its own protocol, separate from HTTP, which can affect rules that match on `app-layer-protocol:!http`. For information about the upgrade, see [Upgrading 7.0 to 8.0](https://docs.suricata.io/en/latest/upgrade.html#upgrading-7-0-to-8-0) on the Suricata website and the [Suricata User Guide](https://docs.suricata.io/en/suricata-8.0.3/index.html) on the Suricata website.  | July 20, 2026 |

cells.Description: Network Firewall upgraded from Suricata version 7.0 to 8.0.3. This might require changes in your use of Network Firewall. For information about the upgrade, see [Upgrading 7.0 to 8.0](https://docs.suricata.io/en/latest/upgrade.html#upgrading-7-0-to-8-0) on the Suricata website and the [Suricata User Guide](https://docs.suricata.io/en/suricata-8.0.3/index.html) on the Suricata website.
